resume: A seven-track drum machine porting Erica Synths LXR-02 firmware to FM-1. Six voices with a direct 16-step grid per bar, four-bar patterns, sound locks, flams, rolls, kit morphing, scene-based performance tools and song arrangements.

commandes.role: SHIFT. Hold while using keys or panel buttons for alternate operations and mute/solo controls.
COPY. Hold and press a track, bar or pattern to copy; works with sound parameters for Control All.
Master FX bus, drive, phaser/flanger, delay, reverb and master compression.
Scale controls and keyboard settings.
Voice amplitude and modulation envelopes.
Two LFOs, random-per-hit, cross-modulation and choke settings.
Voice synthesis and sound model pages. With SHIFT: enter keyboard voice-play mode.
Mixer, output, FX/reverb sends, MIDI and clock-sync configuration.
Main 16-step grid, patterns and song views; SHIFT + HOME resets performance effects.
Save or load kits, patterns, songs, morph snapshots and projects.
Live performance pages: rolls, mute effects, stutter, density and modulation.
Track sequencer and step detail pages: chance, condition, ratchets, note/velocity, shifts, locks and lengths.
Start and stop the sequencer.
Arm recording for the selected track.
Overall output level.
Change the selected page or sequencer editing view.
Browse kit and sound libraries.
Select a drum track or voice.
Tap white keys 1–16 to toggle steps of the currently selected bar. Other views use the keys for patterns or performance actions.
Keys 1–7 choose tracks; keys 8–11 choose the displayed bar. SHIFT/COPY modify their behavior.

gestes: Tap a white key to switch a step on or off on the grid; hold that step and turn a knob on a sound page to create a parameter lock.
Hold COPY (OCT+) and tap a bar key to copy a bar's steps.
Select a track using the black keys and a bar using the other black keys.

modes.texte: A pattern can contain up to four 16-step bars. There are 32 patterns and song arrangement, with kits, morphing and 128 kit-library positions.
PERF has rolls, DJ filter, FILL, density, stutter and other effects; they can alter playback without permanently changing the underlying pattern.

a_savoir: LXR-02 sound-engine port; unofficial and not endorsed by Erica Synths.
The native build uses Elixir's own fixed-point WebAssembly simulation. Imported USB library features may not be accessible through the generic FM-1 panel.
